Quotations — a selection of short lines and thoughts from characters in the Polari series, as well as proverbs, commandments, and sayings heard in the world of Polari. The Russian source quotes the books verbatim; omissions within quotations are marked with an ellipsis, “…” Each quotation is followed by its speaker, book, chapter, and circumstances.

Erwin Origin

“Nothing beautiful should smell of poverty”

— Erwin, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 2, “Arrow” (looking down on First Winter from above)

“This cave, gentlemen, leads to the Underworld. We have found a Gift of the Gods.”

— Erwin, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 22, “Arrow” (to his companions on the explorada)

“If there is one thing I have never liked in my life, my lady, it is order.”

— Erwin, Only One Star, chapter “Arrow” (to Alanis, standing beside her on the throne)

“There are no clean victories. Every triumph feeds the vultures.”

— Erwin, A Doll on the Throne, chapter “Northern Bird – 1” (to his sister Iona, on the price of victory)

“I hate you, Lord Chancellor. Begin every morning with those words.”

— Erwin, A Doll on the Throne, chapter “Spark – 10” (to Minerva, advising her not to conceal her hostility towards him)

“We are the ones who make traditions, General… We live in an age of change!”

— Erwin, A Doll on the Throne, chapter “Northern Bird – 6” (to General Gore of the spark troops, who objects to a northerner commanding the army)

“I am Erwin Sophia Jessica of Agatha's lineage. Enough sitting idle. Let us go to war.”

— Erwin, The Shadow of the Great Tree, chapter “Arrow — 5” (to a garrison commander, after revealing his name)

“Characters are forever concealing things; that is what gives a plot its intrigue. Real people lie in just the same way.”

— Erwin, The Shadow of the Great Tree, chapter “Arrow — 8” (to Father David, disbelieving his account)

Minerva

“I am alive. I am clever. I am a spark.”

— Mira, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 10, “Spark” (to herself, shaking off her apathy after being insulted at court)

“You are the best enemy the gods could have created.”

— Mira, Only One Star, chapter “Spark” (to Iona Origin)

“Look: there is all the ice you could want on the river. And I am a Yanmei, and I need a bridge.”

— Mira, Only One Star, chapter “Spark” (to a general, explaining why she needs the Glove of Might)

“Justice exists”

— Mira, A Doll on the Throne, chapter “Spark – 11” (correcting Salem, who had said “Truth exists”)

“I am too tired to forgive. That is the trouble.”

— Minerva, Those We Forgive (to Captain Shatterhand, refusing to forgive Leila Talmir)

“I am staying in Faunterra. This is my city. As long as I live, the horde will not reach it!”

— Minerva, The Shadow of the Great Tree, chapter “Spark — 2” (to the capital's troops before the horde's invasion)

Harmon Paula Roger

“People are the best entertainment.”

— Harmon, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 4, “Coin” (the merchant's favourite saying)

“A good merchant buys people and sells himself”

— Harmon, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 1, “Coin” (to himself, on the day he intended to buy a person)

“Nobles rule swords and castles… But merchants have long been the ones in charge of gold.”

— Harmon, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 30, “Coin” (to Joaquin, who had said “Nobles rule the world”)

“You may never fly that far… But you can try.”

— Horam, The Skyship and the Girl (on the dream of flying there in a skyship)

“The gods can wait”

— Harmon, The Yanmei Hunt, chapter “Coin — 8” (looking away from the speaking Sphere to save Niza)

“When my Louisa arrives, tell her to go to the bank. Tell her this too: Harmon Paula knows what a scoundrel he was”

— Harmon, The Shadow of the Great Tree, chapter “Coin — 2” (in a letter to the innkeeper)

Iona Origin

“My kind brother has never drawn a blade in my honour, and I am so grateful to him for that!..”

— Iona, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 12, “Coin” (to Joaquin, who wanted to fight for her honour)

“I am tired of death. I know how cold the world is without you.”

— Iona, Only One Star, chapter “Arrow” (to her brother, begging him not to send her away)

“Life in peacetime is a nightmare. That is what Duke Origin used to say. Tomorrow war will begin, and things will be livelier at once.”

— Iona, Only One Star, chapter “Arrow” (to Erwin on the eve of battle, after slapping him)

“Everyone knows what the jester is in the traditions of the Yanmei Dynasty: a man who has lost everything.”

— Iona, Only One Star, chapter “Spark” (to Mira, interpreting the cards)

“Erwin, do not think of me… Kill the monsters!”

— Iona, Humans and Gods, chapter “Sword-3” (to her brother through a spark bracelet, while Shayland's captive)

“You could have done no differently. Neither could I. No one has the power to change anything.”

— Iona, The Shadow of the Great Tree, chapter “Sword — 4” (to Joaquin, who expected her to accuse him)

Mark the Raven

“The only clue that cannot be fabricated is a deduction. The only infallible proof is logic.”

— Mark, Only One Star, chapter “Pen” (the investigator's credo)

“And yes, may the darkness devour you, the future is always more important than the past!”

— Mark, Only One Star, chapter “Pen” (to Ethan, about Lady Gloria's case)

“What difference does it make whether he is a god?”

— Mark, The Shadow of the Great Tree, chapter “Spark — 3” (to Minerva, about Navi)

Joaquin Eve Hannah

“The fog will hide us — that too is our strength! Invisibility is the best shield, and we will move quietly.”

— Joe, A Doll on the Throne, chapter “Sword – 3” (to Salem's militiamen before an attack in the fog)

“better to be a master at trading than a master at killing people”

— Joaquin, The Yanmei Hunt, chapter “Sword — 4” (to himself, proud of a successful deal)

Manson

“Clever girl! I love clever girls, everyone loves clever girls!”

— Manson, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 31, “Spark” (about Mira, after jumping down from the balustrade)

“A cleverrr enemy, Sovereign! Do not underrate him! Dangerousss…”

— Manson, Only One Star, chapter “Cap” (to Adrian, about Erwin Origin)

“Adrian is alive! He is alive, you brainless creatures, you fools!”

— Manson, The Yanmei Hunt, chapter “Voice of the Crown, 28 May 1775” (to the Chamber, revealing the central joke)

“…every choice will be wrong until you learn how to choose!”

— Manson, Humans and Gods, chapter “Spark-4” (to Mira, in an argument over which goblet to serve)

“The one with wine in it!”

— Manson, Humans and Gods, chapter “Spark-4” (to Mira, when asked which goblet she should have chosen)

Adrian

“I am the emperor, my lady.”

— Adrian, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 20, “Spark” (to Mira, who had asked him to be careful)

“Better. The truth is always better.”

— Adrian, Only One Star, chapter “Cap” (to Captain Beckfield during a sword duel)

“Why does everyone I trust betray me?.. Why are people like ice floes on a river? The moment you lean on one, you fall straight into the water…”

— Adrian, Only One Star, chapter “Cap” (to Manson)

“My lady, you are a Yanmeian, which is why I allowed you to save face. I gave you a chance to surrender while you are on top. When you are on the bottom, there will be no second chance.”

— Adrian, The Shadow of the Great Tree, chapter “Spark — 7” (to Minerva during negotiations before battle)

“What does a trickster need a beacon for? What makes gods different from humans?”

— Adrian, The Shadow of the Great Tree, chapter “Witness — 5” (to his wife Magda)

Alanis Almera

“We are in Faunterra! We are the heart of the Empire! We are only one Star!”

— Alanis, Only One Star, chapter “Sword” (embracing Erwin and Damon after the palace is taken)

“Power is what is beneath you… It is a pyramid!”

— Alanis, Only One Star, chapter “Arrow” (to Erwin, standing on the throne in the Small Throne Room)

“Don't want a ci-ity, want a du-uchy…”

— Alanis, The Yanmei Hunt, chapter “Arrow — 3” (to Erwin as she falls asleep — her unchanging complaint)

“I cannot turn aside or go back. I will follow this road to the end. That is the only way.”

— Alanis, Humans and Gods, chapter “Star-1” (to herself, held captive aboard a ship)

Other Origins

“I failed to instil either wisdom or dignity in him, and I am prepared to answer for that mistake. I choose myself.”

— Desmond Origin, The Shadow of the Great Tree, chapter “Arrow” (to Richard, choosing who will die — himself or his son)

“Enough playing at cunning. We have the strength now! Let the weak resort to tricks!”

— Damon, Only One Star, chapter “Arrow” (to his cousin Erwin at a war council)

“Have you lost your mind?! We are winning!”

— Damon, Only One Star, chapter “Arrow” (to Erwin, who has proposed a retreat)

“The forces of good will triumph in this play!”

— Sophia Origin, The Shadow of the Great Tree, chapter “Mask” (refusing to hear bad news)

Father David

“We are murderers, scoundrels, and scum. Does that sound better to your ears?”

— Father David, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 45, “Coin” (to Harmon, offering him the chance to join their side)

“I am not the one you should fear. Believe that much, at least.”

— Father David, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 45, “Coin” (to Harmon, after showing him a vial of poison)

“Forgive yourself, Your Grace. And farewell.”

— Father David, Only One Star, chapter “Arrow” (to Erwin after a conversation about the price of war)

“Nothing in the world is more bitter than a strong person's tears.”

— Father David, Only One Star, chapter “Arrow” (to Alanis)

Northerners and Shaylands

“Girls often overestimate their power over men.”

— Jemis, A Doll on the Throne, chapter “Spark – 9” (to Minerva, who intends to charm the Shavan chieftain)

“Lords do not like to count. Now that is an unforgivable eccentricity.”

— Vittor, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 12, “Coin” (to Harmon, repeating his father's words)

“I am a coward. I am scared to death of you, so I will never break my oath. Fear is stronger than honour. Fear is stronger than anything.”

— Vittor, Humans and Gods, chapter “The Price of Fear-2” (to Desmond Origin, kneeling before him)

“A weapon is meant to have neither conscience nor guilt. A weapon does not ponder morality.”

— Vittor, The Shadow of the Great Tree, chapter “Sword — 4” (to Joaquin, who has asked to be judged)

“We. Are allowed. Anything.”

— Martin, Humans and Gods, chapter “Sword-3” (to Joaquin, putting Iona in a cage)

Grandfather and Navi

“Fear, Raven — that is what guides you.”

— Grandfather, A Doll on the Throne, chapter “Pen – 8” (to Mark)

“Do not be afraid. You will be all right.”

— Navi, Humans and Gods, chapter “Witness-4” (to Karen, when they are separated)

“It is not the Shavans who threaten you, but your own people! Fear the generals, fear Labelin!”

— Navi, The Shadow of the Great Tree, chapter “Spark — 3” (to Minerva, as the guards lead him away)

“The Gifts of the gods are crash sites. Sacred Objects are parts of wrecked starships.”

— Navi, The Shadow of the Great Tree, chapter “Northern Bird” (to Mira)

“The choice is yours.”

— Nathaniel, The Shadow of the Great Tree, chapter “Northern Bird” (to the empress — the final words of the series)

Magda Labelin and Moger Buckley

“Money and those who have it — that is who should rule the world!”

— Magda, Useful People (to her father and Buckley)

“Do you love my arse?”

— Magda, Useful People (to her companion on the ship, who has begun paying her compliments)

“there are only two approaches: from above or from below. You simply have to choose the right one.”

— Buckley, Useful People (to himself, about his trade)

“We will build a world without knights, fair lady!”

— Buckley, Useful People (to Magda)

“…a boy or a girl? A girl or a boy? Just answer me, and then you can lie.”

— Buckley, The Yanmei Hunt, chapter “Coin — 4” (to Rico, while searching for Horam)

Other Characters

“Sooner or later I will get what is mine. The West has a long memory.”

— Moran, A Doll on the Throne, chapter “Companions – 2” (to Neimir)

“Between us, we know everyone in the world.”

— Salem, A Doll on the Throne, chapter “Sword – 2” (to Joaquin, about his three advisers)

“The empress is a girl of eighteen. I remember being eighteen — there was only one thing on my mind. And believe me, that one thing had nothing to do with justice.”

— Louisa, A Doll on the Throne, chapter “Sword – 4” (to Salem, who is going to the sovereign in search of justice)

“Grieve quietly, but rejoice loudly.”

— Polly, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 9, “Coin” (to Harmon, citing Saint Yanmei)

“I am no match for you, and you are no match for me. We will not be happy together.”

— Polly, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 36, “Coin” (to Joaquin, as she leaves him)

“Shove your lordship where it belongs; I am not a count!”

— Sir Womack, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 18, “Coin” (to Harmon, who has addressed him as “Your Lordship”)

“Feeling is a risk! If I love my wife, my enemies will be able to manipulate me through her.”

— Hightower, The Confidante (to Rose, whom he has decided to marry)

“A sorcerer is someone who possesses special knowledge and can do what other people cannot.”

— Mik, Now You Are a Sorcerer (to Nathaniel (Navi), who has admitted: “I am a sorcerer”)

“Trust, like a horse, is sold only as a whole. You cannot trust by halves.”

— the Newcomer, A Doll on the Throne, chapter “Companions – 6” (to Chara)

Fantasies

“Money is good, but conscience is worth more. I have never executed the innocent in my life, and I will not let another executioner do it.”

— Walter Jane John, Fantasies, A Routine Matter (to the lawman Macfrid Crow, persuading him to go to Finborough)

“A criminal is a human being, not a pig for slaughter.”

— Walter Jane John, Fantasies, A Routine Matter (to Burgomaster Brickman, demanding to see the condemned man beforehand)

“Every evildoer will be punished, even a dog”

— Baron Reginald Devo, Fantasies, A Routine Matter (demanding that the dog Biter be put on trial)

Proverbs and Sayings of the World

“There is only one star”

— a saying about the emperor in the capital, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 17, “Spark” (quoted by Ethan: “That is what people say here,” in Faunterra)

“My vassal's vassal is not my vassal. It has always been so, my lord.”

— a northern custom, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 8, “Arrow” (Captain Theobart says this to Erwin)

“Origins do not retreat!”

— a saying of the Origins, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 29, “Arrow” (Iona, in a playful exchange with Erwin)

“You will make decisions without our help. That is a mortal's right, and a mortal's curse.”

— Scripture, Arrow, Coin, Spark, chapter 45, “Coin” (quoted by Father David)

“Accept your place in the world with dignity. You are not the sovereign, my lord. Accept it”

— Voice of Winter (an inscription on the ribbon around a snowdrop brought to Erwin by a servant with the words “A gift from the empress”; the first sentence is the first commandment, see The Gates of Trust)

“Use what you know, sell what you have.”

— Count Vincent Shayland's favourite saying, Humans and Gods, chapter “The Price of Fear-1” (Vittor's father)

“If every way out of a situation is bad, break the situation itself.”

— Clive Stagfort's advice, A Doll on the Throne, chapter “Spark – 7” (this is how he taught Mira to play Stratems)

“The hungry do not believe the well-fed.”

— the moral of Grandfather's parable of the wolf and the dog, The Yanmei Hunt, chapter “Arrow — 4”

“Desire is a valuable thing… Someone who wants a great deal is useful”

— a saying of Buckley's employer, Useful People

“May everything you dream of come true!”

— a wish for Spring Dawn, The Yanmei Hunt, chapter “Witness — 1” (see Calendar)

“The me of today is better than the me of yesterday”

— a saying among the clinic's patients, The Yanmei Hunt, chapter “Witness — 1” (repeated by Dorothy — Sybil Northwood)

“A decision comes from knowledge, not from will”

— Agatha in Moments, Humans and Gods, chapter “Witness-3”

“It is the sincere, not the all-knowing, who pass through the gates.”

— Lord Emmon Darklin, the Lady in the Dark's castellan, The Gates of Trust (to Gerion and the beggar, who made the wrong choice, after the prophet Francis-Ilian passed through the third gate)
toc: Proverbs and Sayings of the World
